sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed (3 times / year) bases as 
indicated by M4 in the title block.

The technical 
specification of the isolator is: rated 
current = 2000 A, rated voltage = 500 kv

The first draft initiated, reviewed and tested by Eng. 
Solimean A.Elftah on 20/6/2004, accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.

This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear safety equipment as helmet, shoes, ... etc
Switch off isolator
Switch off the AC supply, DC supply
Switch on the earthling at disconnector sides
Safety helmet and safety shoes
